PASSENGER INFORMATION
BAGGAGE ALLOWANCE
INTERNATIONAL SERVICE (NEW YORK-MEXICO):
FIRST CLASS - 30 KILOS (66 Ibs.)
TOURIST CLASS - 20 KILOS (44 lbs.)
DOMESTIC SERVICE: 25 KILOS (55 Ibs.)
Domestic flights are those originating from the
gateways of Tijuana, Nogales and C. Juarez.
Baggage in excess of the free allowance will
be charged for at the rate of 1% of the normal
adult one-way First Class fare per kilo.
ARRIVAL AT AIRPORT OF EMBARKATION
Passengers on flights originating at border
cities should arrive at the airport at
least one full hour before scheduled departure
time in order to complete necessary Government
and Airline formalities.
CHILDREN'S FARE
Accompanied children 2 years of age or over,
but under 12 years of age will be charged
one-half the normal adult fare. Children over 12
will be charged full adult fare. One child under 2
years, not occupying a seat, will be carried free
with each full-paying passenger. Additional
children under 2 will be charged for at one-half
the normal adult fare and may occupy a seat.
CLAIMS
If claims for damaged baggage and/ or
personal property are not filed at the airport
immediately upon consumation of the flight,

REFUNDS
In the case where definite reservations have
been made and are cancelled at the passenger's
request, the fare will be refunded provided the
passenger notifies Aeronaves de Mexico at least
